reviews.review_description:
My main jabs are at the graphics and the bots. 
As we should know, standalone vr has very limited capabilities in terms of running game that look good, so that's not my issue. What is though are the missing things; like bullets visually being in an empty mag, random low poly objects in the hideout, and the explosions not looking great.
My other issue is the A.I, like i stated, vr games that support standalone have to be able to run well, but the A.I is just plain bad. For example, a police officer will just stand still while shooting you. 
Apart from those issues, that game is fun as hell and a good continuation of the paydays series.

Heists are thoughtfully designed, with multiple approaches and genuinely satisfying stealth puzzles. When stealth fails, the difficulty scales nicely as things go loud.

Unfortunately, matchmaking is a mess. Lobbies default to public, so quick match repeatedly drops you into games where the host immediately kicks you. Worse, the player base seems dominated by children under 10 shouting "You weady?!" who have zero interest in stealth, which is the best part of the game. Given the profane dialogue, you'd think Meta would have an issue with this.

Solo play on the highest difficulty is effectively impossible. Most heists are manageable with stealth, but the finale forces you loud early, and the useless AI teammates actually get in your way (blocking the railway).

They're already advertising DLC with "exclusive skills and gadgets." Cosmetics are fine; paid gameplay advantages aren't.

Fun, fairly priced, and clever, but adults should bring friends. Replayability may fade once you've earned every achievement.

As a person who has played both Payday 2 and 3 on xbox, I am very pleased with the game,  you should definitely buy this game if you want a fun heisting game. My only gripe with the game is the animations for player characters, I just wish they didn't have the same animations as the ai bots when you two hand your weapons. Could you maybe please make it where you can kinda be more expressive with your character movements? kinda like contractors. Other than that, it's a great game to get.

reviews.review_title: It's fun but needs some work
reviews.review_description: I think it's very promising but the guns need some work. Gunplay is good but they aren't super accurate and the recoil with the one handed pistol is ridiculous. Considering I need to shoot one handed when using or carrying something it's not super fun to deal with. The hits could use some feedback too, it feels like I'm triggering static death animation, and then I have to wait for that guard to die to get the one behind him. All small issues, the core of the game is very good otherwise.

Payday: Aces High is good fun, full stop. There are a couple ifs, ands, or buts. But I want to stress that my opinion of this game is “it’s a good time. But…” not “a good time, but…”
That period versus a comma makes a huge difference, you know. I had fun playing this game! I think the character designs are superb. The heisters here have masks that are super cool to look at in VR, and I very much appreciate the diverse personalities within the crew.

At the same time, there were a couple things in the game that made me go “… eh?”
- I come from Payday 2. I like Payday 2’s stealth. While I’m sure the stealth in Aces High is supposed to work differently from 2, it’s not clear whether or not I’m supposed to be able to move guards after I shoot them in stealth. The collision between your hands and the ragdoll is inconsistent, and the body sometimes, just… vanishes if you clip into it weird. This existed in the playtest. I thought it was a bug but now I can’t tell if it’s a strange feature. The lack of body bags in this game despite guards clearly being able to spot their fallen comrades does not exactly help in the confusion, either.
- You can’t turn the pump-action shotgun upside down to reload it tactical style. Attempting to hold it as such will snap the gun back right-side up. You can still theoretically reload like a hitman if you hold the controller in an unintended way or contort your wrist, but that’s… unfortunate.
- You can’t do the AK reload. You know the one: you run dry, you grab a new mag, and knock the old one out of the magwell like a loose tooth. Attempting to do that here causes the new mag to phase through the empty one, zero collision. You can simply press the mag release button on your controller when the two make contact if you want to be immersed so badly, but… shoot, man, almost every other VR shooter out there has the AK reload, but we don’t. That’s an interesting decision that I will respect if there was some intention behind it.

There could potentially be some more, but there are probably better places to dump that much text.

Look, what I’ve been trying to say this whole time is:
Payday: Aces High is fun. If you like the franchise and want to support the IP, buy it. At the same time, there are some subtleties that can impede your immersion, turning an immersive VR shooting experience into what feels like an arcade game with a Payday themed paint job… plus we stuck some goggles on your face while we were at it.

Should I be making remarks on the immersion of my VR “officer of the law shooting” simulator? No more questions, gamer. Buy Payday: Aces High, purchase the Yasha Pro, and get to blasting. It’s a great time.

Grappling hook doesn't grapple, guns give out whenever they want to, perks are so miniscule you can play with or without them, you can't even put a bag on your back like every other Payday game, and they're delaying updates because of GTA 6. Happens a bunch where I just drop the gun I was using and go to my sidearm to get outta trouble. The sidearms re-rack easily, it’s the other firearms.  If that gets fixed the game will become much more enjoyable for me.  
Love the upgrade system as well. Tons of stuff to unlock and buy. There’s easily 30-40 hrs of gameplay to unlock everything.  I’d give solo play an 8/10 and multiplayer a 9.3/10.

Secondly, regarding the Classic Gun: When you buy it as a DLC, it becomes unlocked in the in-game store when you can then acquire it by spending some of the in-game currency you get from playing and completing heists. reviews.review_title: Games fun, but it has some hiccups
reviews.review_description:
The main problem i have with it is the numbers. It has some hordes, but not a lot. It also suffers from fhe classic payday 2 difficulty scaling where the difference between very hard and overkill is like a nail to the knee and a sword to the neck. 

The skills are also a bit odd and the guns cluld use kore attachments but the game did just come out ao I assume some changes are coming (I mean payday 2 and 3 dis have skill changes down fhe line so I wouldnt say it couldnt happen) but I still believe ghe provlem is the enemies. I was hoping for a large horde with moderate health to make full auto guns better to use rather than semi autos and shotguns. 

The bags are also a bit iffy. Grabbing one fordes you to use your secondary. Id love to be able to put it on my.back at rhe cost of slow movement speed. And (this is more personal) but there isnt any virtual stock. And im an absolute lover of virtual shocks.

The units are also odd. Of course we got beat cops, swat, snipers, tasers (kinda), snd dozers. But no cloakers or medic. Swapped in turn of a swat with a ahotgun loaded with game over shells. Its a bit uninspired imo

And even with the flaws above, It is ABSOLUTELY worth ghe price. Id go as far to say its rhr most faithful recreation of thr payday formual you could've done on modern day VR software. I also paid for the dlc brcause i believe with enough funding this team can make something amazing. And i am already taking bets on what fhe first collab DLC is gonna be (MY MONEYS ON A STRIDE OR PRISONBOSS VR DLC BUT IDK)

You never receive them. There is only 6 heists available as of now, but with a free heist coming this Christmas this game has lots of potential. Good job payday team!

Also when you reach the exit, I shouldn’t have to remove the bags from them. Speaking of which. There needs to be a countdown once you’re in the exit zone. I’m in the sewers wondering why the mission wouldn’t end. I look up and there’s a bag icon 300 something meters away back at the bank. Let me go. ￼


Otherwise it’s F-ing incredible. It does a great job of  creating a sense of urgency.

This is not a traditional payday game theres alot more cooperation you cant rely on skills or armour. You need tactics. it's fantastic, BUT my 1 complaint is the variants of weapons say with the m4 for example a upgraded variant will decrease accuracy and increase damage or the other way round that's good but it makes the gun a ugly yellow pink or camo colour I think they should ad colour changing or make them the standard black

Me and my nephew are absolutely loving this game! However there is one thing that’s bugging me.. the lack of achievements on Meta! Eventually there’s gonna be no reason for me to play after beating everything… but achievements, like on the steam version, would fix that so fast! 🙏🙏

I'm a longtime Payday 2 player. I was horribly disappointed by Payday 3.
 
Aces High is in some respect a bit unpolished, lacking in content, and the gameplay is a bit different from what I've come to expect. Theres not quite as much interactivity and the build customization is lacking. Unless I'm misunderstanding it, theres also no heist preplanning.

The looting also kinda sucks. I think it would have been better if we could carry 1 bag on our back, and then optionally carry 2 by hand. You can't reload while transporting. It'd be nice if your level of greed was proportional to your ability to defend. Also, there just isnt enough loot. Payday 2 has you running a relay for like 20 bags sometimes, but here... theres like maybe 6 things to grab in any heist. I guess its better for short sessions but it sucks that you cant just clean a whole place out like in other games.

Also, no jump button? Okay, fine. At least let me ledge grab windows to vault through them or something.

That said: I am enjoying this game and I consider it to be one of the best examples of what VR can be on this platform. Theres a is a decent amount to do here. The gunplay is decent enough. Theres enough of what I like about Payday to want to stick with this game for a bit.

I have to give it a very solid 4 stars. Plenty of room for improvement, but I am totally on board with the foundation laid so far. I'd say its worth playing but im really hoping we get more dynamic heists going forwards

Finally a decent fps with fun missions and mechanics for interacting with tools etc. Not over the top just enough for a bit of immersion and the shooting actually takes some skill and patience to aim. Super fun so far just finished the tutorial bout to dive into my next heist!

reviews.review_title: If your a payday fan you will LOVE this
reviews.review_description: This game is literally payday in vr, no shade, the ai system, breaking into vaults, all of it. This is a masterpiece, the community is great, the guns are smooth, and the art style of this game is so so SO good! most of the 1 star reviews is due to NOT DOING THE TUTORIAL!!!

reviews.review_title: the absolute best mission based game
reviews.review_description: In all my years I have never seen a game that just makes me want to weep like this one. It is so good. The Npc could be more realistic but that’s it. It’s 12/10 no notes. I genuinely think this is the best game on the quest (in the mission genre of course)
